Eligibility:

  • Participants can register solo or as part of a team.

Team Composition:

  • Team size: 1 to 4 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed. Members do not need to be from the same college or institution.
  • Inter-specialization/inter-branch teams are allowed. Members can be from any academic background (CS, IT, ECE, or non-technical branches) — cybersecurity draws on a mix of skills, and mixed teams are welcome.
  • Each participant may be part of only one team. Duplicate registrations across multiple teams are not permitted.

Format — Jeopardy-style CTF:

  • Hosted on CTFd; platform access and login details will be shared with registered participants ahead of the event.

  • Exact start time will be communicated to registered participants and posted on the event page.

Rules:

  • Registration is free and must be completed before the stated deadline. Late registrations will not be accepted.

  • Prize and certificate eligibility may be subject to a brief verification step (e.g., a short writeup or walkthrough of solved challenges) for top-placing teams.
